bugs.summary: At 390px, the mobile sidebar is permanently rendered on top of page content and overlaps the hamburger menu button, making the sidebar toggle (open/close) unusable.
bugs.root_cause: In AppShell.tsx the wrapper div (`fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 ... -translate-x-full ... md:translate-x-0`) that is supposed to slide the sidebar off-screen when closed computes to `transform: none` in the browser (verified via page.evaluate getComputedStyle) instead of translateX(-100%). Because the <aside> itself is independently `position: fixed; inset-y-0 left-0`, it ends up pinned to the viewport's top-left corner regardless of the wrapper's intended transform/open state, so the sidebar is always visible and intercepts pointer events on data-testid=mobile-menu-button.
bugs.evidence: Screenshot after demo login at 390x844 shows the full sidebar open over the dashboard even though no toggle was clicked; getComputedStyle(wrapper).transform === 'none' while wrapper.className correctly includes '-translate-x-full'; Playwright click on mobile-menu-button times out after 30s with '<sparkles-svg> from <div class="-translate-x-full fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 ..."> subtree intercepts pointer events'. Backend/API health was not implicated (GET /api/risk-signals and others return 200/401 correctly, confirming this is frontend-only).

action_items: Fix the mobile sidebar CSS in AppShell.tsx so the closed state actually translates the sidebar off-screen (transform resolves to none instead of translateX(-100%)); likely needs the translate utility applied to the element that also carries position:fixed, or a transform-creating ancestor so the <aside>'s own `fixed` doesn't escape to the viewport.
